name: developer-plenger
description: An end-to-end, spec-driven development workflow shipped as one plugin. Seven skills cover the whole path: init registers the pack in AGENTS.md, plan turns an idea into a specification, slice cuts the spec into vertical-slice phases and tasks, exec writes the code, review audits it against the spec, check proves it with tests, and fix repairs what review and check surface. Each skill owns a distinct artifact or a distinct checkbox transition, and writes its progress into a file rather than into the conversation.
